body.objective: Students will be able to describe transportation and directions.
body.iCan: I can describe transportation and directions.
successCriteria: I can name ways to travel in Mandarin
I can ask for and give directions
I can describe how I get somewhere
body.hook: Many large Chinese cities have huge subway systems, high-speed trains and bike-share everywhere. Knowing how to talk about transportation and ask for directions is essential if you ever travel there, or help a visitor in Calgary or Vancouver.

vocabulary.term: 往左拐 / 往右拐 wǎng zuǒ guǎi / wǎng yòu guǎi

study.title: 请问，怎么走？
study.question: How do I talk about travel and directions in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Transportation: 坐公共汽车 zuò gōnggòng qìchē (take the bus), 坐地铁 zuò dìtiě (take the subway), 坐火车 zuò huǒchē (take the train), 坐飞机 zuò fēijī (take a plane), 骑自行车 qí zìxíngchē (ride a bike), 开车 kāi chē (drive), 走路 zǒu lù (walk).
Pattern: Subject + 坐/骑 + vehicle + 去 + place. 我坐地铁去学校。Wǒ zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào. = I take the subway to school.
Directions: 一直往前走 yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu (go straight), 往左拐 (turn left), 往右拐 (turn right), 在…对面 duìmiàn (across from), 在…旁边 (next to).
Dialogue:
游客 Yóukè (tourist)：请问，地铁站在哪儿？Qǐngwèn, dìtiě zhàn zài nǎr?
学生 Xuésheng：地铁站离这儿不远。您一直往前走，到第二个路口往右拐。地铁站在银行旁边。
Dìtiě zhàn lí zhèr bù yuǎn. Nín yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, dào dì-èr gè lùkǒu wǎng yòu guǎi. Dìtiě zhàn zài yínháng pángbiān.
游客：走路要多长时间？Zǒu lù yào duō cháng shíjiān?
学生：大概十分钟。Dàgài shí fēnzhōng.
游客：谢谢！
学生：不客气！Bú kèqi!
English support: 请问 = excuse me (may I ask); 离这儿不远 = not far from here; 路口 = intersection; 银行 = bank; 要多长时间 = how long does it take; 大概 = about; 不客气 = you're welcome.
Activity: Using a map of your school's neighbourhood, take turns asking for and giving directions to three places.
study.source: Original dialogue written for this lesson.
steps: Practise 坐/骑 + vehicle + 去 + place
Read the dialogue with a partner
Give directions on a neighbourhood map
discussion: How long does it take to walk there?
Why does 坐 mean "take" for buses and trains?
How do you get to school, and how would you say it?
study.product: Write directions in characters and pinyin from your school to two nearby places, and describe how you travel to school, including the time it takes.

examples.title: Transportation
examples.problem: Say "I ride my bike to school."
steps: 骑 + 自行车 + 去 + place
examples.answer: 我骑自行车去学校。Wǒ qí zìxíngchē qù xuéxiào.

examples.title: Asking directions
examples.problem: Ask "Excuse me, where is the bank?"
examples.answer: 请问，银行在哪儿？Qǐngwèn, yínháng zài nǎr?

examples.title: Giving directions
steps: 一直往前走，然后往左拐
examples.answer: 一直往前走，然后往左拐。

examples.title: Time
examples.problem: Ask "How long does it take by subway?"
examples.answer: 坐地铁要多长时间？Zuò dìtiě yào duō cháng shíjiān?

practice.q: Why does Mandarin use 坐 (sit) for buses and planes?
Translate 学校在图书馆对面。
practice.a: The school is across from the library.

practice.q: Say "I take the subway to school; it takes 20 minutes."
practice.a: 我坐地铁去学校，要二十分钟。

practice.q: Why does the student use 您 nín instead of 你?
practice.a: To be polite to an adult stranger.

misconceptions: Using 坐 for bikes instead of 骑
Putting the place before the vehicle
Forgetting 请问 when asking a stranger
exitTicket: Say how you get to school in Mandarin.

items.q: Mandarin uses 坐 for buses because you
Name four ways to travel in Mandarin.
items.answer: 坐公共汽车, 坐地铁, 骑自行车, 走路.

items.q: How do you ask where something is?

items.answer: Go straight, turn right at the second intersection; it's next to the bank.

items.q: Describe how you get to school.
items.answer: Answers vary; e.g. 我坐公共汽车去学校。
坐 for vehicles you sit in; 骑 for things you straddle, like bikes.

items.q: Ask how long it takes by bus.
items.answer: 坐公共汽车要多长时间？

items.q: Write directions to two nearby places.
Explain why polite forms matter when asking strangers.
items.answer: They show respect, which is valued in Chinese culture.
